content.short: GAMEE is a Web3 gaming and ad-network platform that connects players, brands, and crypto projects.
content.description: GAMEE is a Web3 gaming network powered by the GMEE token. Its site describes connecting gamers, brands, and Web3 projects through play, with a large user base and advertising network for partner campaigns. In the TON set, it is relevant as a Telegram-friendly gaming and user-acquisition platform. GAMEE brings hundreds of millions of users to Web3 and helping projects expand and thrive. The product surface includes web3 adnetwork, powered by $gmee, key numbers, and and we're not stopping here.
